requirement: Point-in-time database storing data vintages so the backtest only ever sees what was knowable as of decision time
acceptance_criterion: Querying any fundamental at date T returns only the vintage available on or before T; lookahead test passes

requirement: Purged cross-validation with embargo periods to prevent train/test leakage
acceptance_criterion: Walk-forward folds purge overlapping-label rows and embargo a gap; leakage placebo collapses toward zero

requirement: True out-of-sample holdout touched exactly once (OOS is a spent budget)
acceptance_criterion: A held-out terminal window is reserved and accessed a single time at final sign-off, not during search

requirement: Multiple-testing discipline: track configurations tested and apply deflated Sharpe / multiple-testing correction
acceptance_criterion: A configuration counter increments per test; reported Sharpe is deflated by the number of trials

requirement: Stationarity is not assumed: decompose performance by regime / sub-period
acceptance_criterion: Every headline metric is reported per regime and per sub-period, not only in aggregate (2022 stock-bond flip as the canonical test)

requirement: Marginal factor contribution measured out-of-sample and after costs
acceptance_criterion: Each factor's value-add is its OOS, cost-adjusted marginal contribution to risk-adjusted return — not in-sample IC

requirement: Full parameter sensitivity surface reported (smooth plateau vs knife-edge)
acceptance_criterion: Sensitivity is reported across the whole parameter range; a single best point is never reported alone

target_phase: All returns are net of modeled costs/slippage; turnover is reported per scheme

requirement: Equal-weight composite is the hard benchmark to beat (no early weight optimization)
acceptance_criterion: Equal-weight factor combination is wired as the baseline; weight optimization is disabled until the framework is trusted AND the owner endorses

requirement: Full metric suite per scheme: OOS Sharpe
column9: Each candidate reports OOS Sharpe, max drawdown, turnover, and sub-period robustness in one comparable table

requirement: Reuse-first: extend the audited Phase 5-C walk-forward harness rather than reinventing leakage-prone paths
acceptance_criterion: The harness imports and reuses the existing Phase 5-C walk-forward / embargo / placebo machinery where applicable

requirement: Surface judgment calls: validation outputs expose options and reasoning for owner endorsement
target_phase: Factor-selection, weighting, and interpretation decisions are presented with options + visible reasoning for the owner to endorse or override
